main_text.p: Spiritum Sanctū, & ꝑ Sanctam gloriosam Dei genetricem,& semper virginem Mariam, & ꝑ quatuor Euangelia, quæ in manibus meis teneo, & ꝑ Sanctos Archangelos Michaelem & Gabrielem, puram conscientiam,germanúmq; seruitium me seruaturum, sacratissimis nostris Dominis Iustiniano, & Theodoræ conjugi ejus,occasione traditæ mihi ab eorum pietate administrationis, & omnem laborem & sudorem, cum fauore, sine dolo et sine arte quæcunque, fusci-pio in commissa mihi ab eis administratione, de eorum Imperio atq; Repub. impendam, & cōmunicator sum Sanctissimæ Dei Catholicæ & Apostolicæ {1}Ecclesiæ, & nullo modo vel tempore Non adÿ-citur Ro-manæ.aduersabor ei, nec quemcunq; permittam in quātum posibilitatem habeo.]

Huic Imperatori suam schedam Regiam, hoc est sententias de officio Regis Paraeneticas dedicauit Agapetus magnę & sacrosanctæ Dei Ecclesiæ Diaconus, quas hunc in modum exorditur. [Honore quolibet sublimiorem quum habeas dignitatem, merito pro omnibus cum qui ista te exornare est dignatus, Deum nempe sum-

page.notes: The marginal note reads "Non adÿ-citur Romanæ." with the hyphenated line breaks as printed. The note is printed as "Ro-manæ." on two lines in the scan. The paragraph ends mid-word "sum-" at the foot of the column, and the paragraph continues on the next page. No catchword or signature is visible. The text is mostly clear. Doubtful readings: "posibilitatem" and "quātum" are copied as printed. The ꝑ forms ("& ꝑ quatuor", "& ꝑ Sanctos") are printed with a stroke through the p. Brackets and italics are as printed.
